scope: 89 selected INT points, final 20M stats block

candidates.test: SbufferEntries 16 to 32, same eviction threshold 8; optional paired followup threshold 8 to 16
candidates.reason: high measured sbufferFullCycles; full eviction label means unsent threshold, not physical full

candidates.test: RAWQEntries 128 to 256, separately RAWDequeuePerCycle 4 to 8 and StoreCompletionWidth 4 to 8
candidates.reason: RAW physically full cycles and replay; completion/dequeue do not uniquely show saturation

candidates.test: RARQEntries 192 to 384, separately RARDequeuePerCycle 4 to 8 and LoadCompletionWidth 8 to 16
candidates.reason: RAR physically full cycles and replay; small overall cycle proportion

limits: per-IQ replayQsize hardcoded 32, not CLI parameter
issueOccupy increments replay issue count, not measured queue capacity full cycles
LoadCompletionWidth and StoreCompletionWidth advance in-order completed indices; not separate completion queue entries
Full cycles, events, occupancy and replay overlap and are not recoverable CPI
cache L2/L3 capacity unchanged by these probes
